title: Selling Plans — Seller Tenure Multiplier on Refund Administration Fees
content:
Long-standing sellers pay a reduced administration fee on a **Selling Plans** refund credit. Tenure runs from the verification date on the seller's selling plan record to the decision date.

**Rule.** The refund administration fee is also multiplied by the long-tenure refund multiplier when the selling plan was verified at least the long tenure months before the decision date, by the mid-tenure refund multiplier when it was verified at least the mid tenure months but fewer than the long tenure months before, and by one otherwise, the tenure being counted in whole months.

The multiplier applies to the refund administration fee as worked out from the credit before the fee and its rate; the product is then rounded to the nearest cent, and only the rounded amount is compared with the cap.

## Multiplier by tenure

| Whole months since verification | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 36 or more (the long tenure months) | 0.5 (long-tenure refund multiplier) |
| 24 to 35 (at least the mid tenure months, fewer than 36) | 0.75 (mid-tenure refund multiplier) |
| Fewer than 24 | One |

## Hypothetical dates (plan verified on 5 October 2022)

| Decision date | Whole months | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 5 October 2025 | 36 | 0.5 |
| 4 October 2025 | 35 | 0.75 |
| 5 October 2024 | 24 | 0.75 |
| 4 October 2024 | 23 | One |
